claim: Wednesday 11 November is the summit's busiest day for founders looking at Europe.
The European Commission and its agencies run most of their sessions on Wednesday 11 November.
A session on EU support for AI businesses is scheduled for 14:30.
A session on EU funding, featuring four EU-funded projects, is scheduled for 15:30.
A session on free access to Europe's supercomputers is scheduled for 16:00.
The 15:30 EU funding session and the 16:00 supercomputer session overlap.
Italian and Portuguese founders and investors meet in Beato from 18:30 in the evening.
The listed times are set by the organisers and can change.
Web Summit has an app that attendees can check for schedule updates.
